name: buddie
description: Buddie makes AI agents more reliable through evidence-based verification, supported automatic answer checks, actionable feedback, and permission-controlled environment diagnostics. Features vary by Claude surface; deterministic Core verification does not use another AI model.

interface.shortDescription: Check an agent's report against the sources it cites, the repo and GitHub before you rely on it.
interface.longDescription: buddie checks what an agent reports: a quotation with a link against a SHA-256 snapshot of that page, a repo anchor (path#sha256, path@commit) against your checkout, pr: and ci: anchors against the GitHub API. No model takes part in the check. In Codex the plugin brings the MCP tools verify_report, snap and source_text (summary is listed too, with data only under Claude Code; environment_snapshot describes the machine categories you granted), the skills that teach anchors, and a Stop hook that sends a final answer with a false quote or anchor back before it reaches you.
defaultPrompt: Verify this report with buddie before we use it.
